notAvailable.zh: 该模型不适用这个模块。
notAvailable.en: This module is not applicable for the selected model.

loadError.zh: 数据加载失败，请检查静态 JSON 或刷新页面。
loadError.en: Failed to load data. Check static JSON files and retry.

provisionalNote.zh: 当前页面中的部分数值来自公开资料整理或示意性占位值，建议后续使用本地脚本覆盖为实测结果。
provisionalNote.en: Some values are public-summary estimates or placeholders. Replace them with locally computed results later.

summary.zh: 以 MLA、DeepSeekMoE 与共享专家为主线，强调训练/推理成本效率。
summary.en: Built around MLA, DeepSeekMoE, and shared experts for cost-efficient scaling.

value.zh: 激活参数受控，KV 缓存更省
value.en: Controlled active params with leaner KV cache

value.zh: 首版为公开资料占位值

summary.zh: 统一的 token 入口，词表规模与多语覆盖会影响 embedding 统计。
summary.en: The token entry point; vocabulary size influences embedding statistics.

inModel.zh: DeepSeek-V3 使用大词表并服务于多语与代码场景，后续可结合词频和 token 类别做分析。
inModel.en: DeepSeek-V3 uses a large vocabulary for multilingual and code-heavy usage.

why.zh: 词表规模会影响 embedding 参数量、投影分布和 lm_head 的结构。
why.en: Vocabulary size shapes embedding volume, projections, and lm_head structure.

compared.zh: 相比 Qwen3 和 Kimi-K2，DeepSeek-V3 的重点不在词表本身，而在后续 MoE 与 attention 的配合。
compared.en: Relative to Qwen3 and Kimi-K2, the main differentiator is not vocab but the downstream MoE and attention design.

summary.zh: 输入 embedding 与输出空间之间的关系，是最适合做静态普查的入口之一。
summary.en: The input embedding space is one of the best starting points for static parameter inspection.

inModel.zh: 首版页面默认展示 embedding 与 lm_head 的相似度摘要，以及投影散点的占位图。
inModel.en: The initial page shows placeholder embedding-vs-lm_head similarity and projection charts.

why.zh: 它能快速反映词表参数的几何结构，也适合做低内存抽样分析。
why.en: It offers a low-memory path to inspect token geometry and output alignment.

compared.zh: 三者都适合先从 embedding 入手，但 DeepSeek-V3 更值得和 shared experts 的统计一起看。
compared.en: All three benefit from embedding-first analysis, but DeepSeek-V3 is especially interesting when paired with shared-expert stats.

summary.zh: DeepSeek-V3 的 attention 重点在 MLA，用更紧凑的 latent 表示控制 KV cache 成本。
summary.en: DeepSeek-V3 focuses on MLA, using compressed latent representations to reduce KV-cache cost.

inModel.zh: 页面中的 attention 模块代表 decoder stack 内的上下文聚合路径，而不是逐层的真实计算图。
inModel.en: The page abstracts the context-aggregation path rather than rendering the exact per-layer computation graph.

why.zh: 如果你的关注点是推理效率、显存与吞吐，attention 设计通常是第一观察位。
why.en: If you care about inference efficiency, memory footprint, and throughput, attention design is the first place to inspect.

compared.zh: 和 Qwen3 的 GQA 风格相比，DeepSeek-V3 的 MLA 更强调压缩 KV 表征；和 Kimi-K2 相比，两者都偏向 MLA 路线，但工程取舍不同。
compared.en: Compared with Qwen3's GQA-like route, DeepSeek-V3 pushes harder on KV compression through MLA; Kimi-K2 also leans toward MLA but with different engineering choices.

summary.zh: DeepSeek-V3 的主体是稀疏激活的专家网络，配合 shared experts 共同构成主要参数体量。
summary.en: DeepSeek-V3 relies on sparsely activated experts, with shared experts contributing to the main parameter budget.

inModel.zh: 页面将 routed experts 与 shared experts 分开描述，便于把专家间相似度和共享专家统计拆开观察。
inModel.en: The page separates routed experts and shared experts to make expert-similarity and shared-expert stats easier to read.

why.zh: 这是解释 active params 与 total params 差异的关键。
why.en: This is the key to understanding the gap between active and total parameters.

compared.zh: 相较 Qwen3，DeepSeek-V3 更强调 shared experts 的设计表达；和 Kimi-K2 相比，专家规模更克制。
compared.en: Compared with Qwen3, DeepSeek-V3 places more emphasis on shared-expert design; compared with Kimi-K2, its expert scale is more restrained.

summary.zh: Router 决定 token 进入哪些专家，是 sparse activation 的入口。
summary.en: The router selects experts for each token and gates sparse activation.

inModel.zh: 首版只展示结构说明，不做 activation 级 router 分析。
inModel.en: The first version focuses on structural explanation rather than activation-level router analysis.

why.zh: 如果后续加入样本级分析，router 会成为最重要的扩展入口。
why.en: If sample-level analysis is added later, the router becomes the most important extension point.

compared.zh: 三者都可以纳入同一抽象模块，但细节统计应留到后续迭代。
compared.en: All three can share the same abstraction, but detailed router stats belong to later iterations.

summary.zh: 共享专家是 DeepSeek-V3 很值得单独强调的一层抽象。
summary.en: Shared experts are important enough in DeepSeek-V3 to deserve their own abstraction.

inModel.zh: 页面默认把 shared experts 作为独立模块，方便和普通 experts 的统计分开对照。
inModel.en: The page treats shared experts as a separate module to compare them against regular experts.

why.zh: 这能帮助理解模型为什么既保持稀疏激活，又保留一定的共享能力。
why.en: It helps explain how the model preserves sparse activation while still maintaining shared capacity.

compared.zh: Qwen3 侧重点不同；Kimi-K2 也可映射到类似概念，但需要后续用真实权重验证相似度结构。
compared.en: Qwen3 places less emphasis here; Kimi-K2 can be mapped to a similar concept but should be validated with real weights later.

summary.zh: 这是整张图的骨架层，强调层级重复与模块组合，而不是还原每一层细节。
summary.en: This is the skeletal layer of the diagram, emphasizing repeated blocks over exact per-layer details.

inModel.zh: 首版以模块聚合方式表达 decoder stack，后续可扩展为二级结构。
inModel.en: The initial version aggregates the decoder stack at the module level, leaving room for second-level details later.

why.zh: 它帮助用户把 attention 与 MoE 放回整体结构中理解。
why.en: It helps users understand attention and MoE inside the overall structure.

compared.zh: 三者都共享 decoder-only 的大框架，但 stack 内部模块的风格差异明显。
compared.en: All three share the broader decoder-only frame, but the internal block styles differ.

summary.zh: LM head 是与 embedding 最容易配对分析的输出模块。
summary.en: The LM head is the most natural output module to pair with embedding analysis.

inModel.zh: 首版用它与 embedding 的相似度摘要来代表输出空间结构。
inModel.en: The first version uses embedding-vs-lm_head similarity as the proxy for output-space structure.

why.zh: 它适合低内存抽样，能快速生成一组稳定的静态统计。
why.en: It works well with low-memory sampling and can quickly yield stable static statistics.

compared.zh: DeepSeek-V3 的重点仍在与 experts 联合观察，而不是单看 lm_head。
compared.en: The more interesting read for DeepSeek-V3 is to view the LM head alongside expert statistics.

summary.zh: 以通用能力、推理模式切换和大规模 MoE 为主线，页面中更强调它作为对照组的清晰性。
summary.en: Built around broad capability, mode switching, and large-scale MoE; this page presents it as a clean comparison target.

value.zh: GQA 风格 Attention + 大规模 MoE
推理模式与通用模式切换
部分结构字段待后续实测补齐
value.en: Some structural fields should be verified later

summary.zh: Qwen3 的词表规模和多语言覆盖使它适合作为 embedding 对照组。
summary.en: Qwen3's large multilingual vocabulary makes it a strong embedding baseline.

inModel.zh: 首版以词表规模和多语覆盖为主，不展开 tokenizer 细节。
inModel.en: The first version focuses on vocabulary size and coverage instead of tokenizer internals.

why.zh: 在多模型比较里，它能帮助解释 embedding 分布的差异。
why.en: In cross-model comparison, it helps explain embedding-distribution differences.

compared.zh: 相比 DeepSeek-V3 与 Kimi-K2，Qwen3 更适合作为通用多语基线。
compared.en: Compared with DeepSeek-V3 and Kimi-K2, Qwen3 serves as a cleaner multilingual baseline.

summary.zh: Qwen3 的 embedding 更适合作为稳定对照组，观察多语与代码 token 的几何分布。
summary.en: Qwen3's embedding works well as a stable baseline for multilingual and code-token geometry.

inModel.zh: 首版中 embedding 部分与 DeepSeek-V3 使用同一套图形模板，便于肉眼对照。
inModel.en: The first release reuses the same chart templates as DeepSeek-V3 for quick visual comparison.

why.zh: 它能帮助分离“词表/输出空间”与“MoE 结构”的影响。
why.en: It helps separate vocabulary/output-space effects from MoE-structure effects.

compared.zh: 如果把 DeepSeek-V3 和 Qwen3 放在同一张参数表里，embedding 的比较通常是最先值得看的位置。
compared.en: If DeepSeek-V3 and Qwen3 are compared in one table, embedding is usually the first worthwhile module to inspect.

summary.zh: Qwen3 在这个页面里主要作为 MLA 路线的对照组，展示更经典的 grouped-query 风格。
summary.en: On this page, Qwen3 acts as a comparison point to MLA-heavy models with a more conventional grouped-query style.

inModel.zh: 页面不追求还原全部 attention 实现细节，而是突出和 DeepSeek/Kimi 的差异。
inModel.en: The page does not aim to reconstruct every attention detail, only the differences versus DeepSeek/Kimi.

why.zh: 作为对照组，它有助于理解为什么另外两家会更强调 MLA 或 cache 压缩。
why.en: As a comparison target, it helps explain why the other two emphasize MLA or KV-cache compression.

compared.zh: 相较 DeepSeek-V3 和 Kimi-K2 的 MLA 路线，Qwen3 的 attention 叙事更直接也更容易读懂。
compared.en: Relative to the MLA-oriented designs of DeepSeek-V3 and Kimi-K2, Qwen3's attention story is more straightforward.

summary.zh: Qwen3-235B-A22B 也是 MoE 模型，但页面中更强调它与其它两者的规模对照。
summary.en: Qwen3-235B-A22B is also an MoE model, but the page emphasizes its scale relative to the other two.

inModel.zh: 首版专家统计为示意性占位数据，主要用于验证页面结构和图表容器。
inModel.en: Initial expert statistics are illustrative placeholders used to validate page structure and chart containers.

why.zh: 对 MoE 模型来说，专家相似度矩阵是后续最值得实测替换的部分之一。
why.en: For MoE models, expert-similarity matrices are among the most important charts to replace with real measurements.

compared.zh: Qwen3 在这里更像中间态：不像 DeepSeek-V3 那么强调 shared experts，也不像 Kimi-K2 那么激进地堆高总参数。
compared.en: Qwen3 sits in the middle: less emphasis on shared experts than DeepSeek-V3 and less aggressive total scale than Kimi-K2.

summary.zh: Router 在 MVP 里只做结构位说明，不承载样本级路由分析。
summary.en: In the MVP, the router is explained structurally without sample-level routing analysis.

inModel.zh: 如果后续要做真实路由分布，这里会成为最自然的扩展入口。
inModel.en: If true routing distributions are added later, this becomes the natural extension point.

why.zh: 把 router 单独抽象出来，有助于后续扩展而不改动主图结构。
why.en: Keeping the router separate preserves extensibility without changing the core diagram.

compared.zh: 三者都共享这个抽象模块，但 MVP 只做解释，不做实测图。
compared.en: All three share this abstract module, but the MVP only explains it without measured charts.

summary.zh: Qwen3 在这个抽象位上的强调较弱，因此当前更像占位说明块。
summary.en: Qwen3 puts less emphasis on this abstraction, so this currently behaves more like a placeholder note block.

inModel.zh: 这里主要用于保持三模型模块布局一致，减少切换成本。
inModel.en: It mainly exists to keep the three-model module layout aligned.

why.zh: 即便某模型不突出 shared experts，这个位置也有利于后续扩展兼容。
why.en: Even if a model does not emphasize shared experts, this slot helps preserve future compatibility.

compared.zh: 相较 DeepSeek-V3，这里更适合作为对照位，而不是重点解释位。
compared.en: Compared with DeepSeek-V3, this is better treated as a comparison slot than as a focal explanation.

summary.zh: Qwen3 更适合作为一个干净的 decoder stack 对照模板。
summary.en: Qwen3 works well as a clean decoder-stack comparison template.

inModel.zh: 首版默认选中这个模块，是因为它能让读者更快建立整体结构印象。
inModel.en: This is the default selected module in the first release because it helps readers build a quick global picture.

why.zh: 对博客型页面来说，先讲清整体结构，再深入某个模块更符合阅读路径。
why.en: For a blog-style page, clarifying the overall stack before diving deep better matches the reading flow.

compared.zh: 它在三者中最适合作为中性对照，不会让视觉重点一开始就被 shared experts 抢走。
compared.en: Among the three, it is the most neutral comparison baseline and avoids letting shared experts dominate the visual story immediately.

summary.zh: Qwen3 的 lm_head 主要用于与 embedding 构成一组稳定的默认统计。
summary.en: Qwen3's LM head is mainly used to form a stable default stat pair with embedding.

inModel.zh: 首版只展示和 embedding 的关系，不在这里展开更细的谱分析。
inModel.en: The first release only shows its relation to embedding and does not expand into deeper spectral analysis.

why.zh: 它是最容易先做出低内存脚本的一部分。
why.en: It is one of the easiest modules to support with low-memory scripts early on.

compared.zh: 作为对照组，Qwen3 更适合先提供一组稳定统计，再逐步扩展细节。
compared.en: As a comparison baseline, Qwen3 is well suited for a stable first-pass stat set.

summary.zh: 用更激进的参数规模和 MLA 路线构成第三个对照点，适合放在页面里看规模化差异。
summary.en: A third comparison point with more aggressive total scale and an MLA-oriented design.

value.zh: 总参数量拉高，但激活参数仍受控
value.en: Larger total scale with controlled active parameters

value.zh: 架构图为便于比较的抽象版
value.en: Architecture diagram is a comparison-oriented abstraction

summary.zh: Kimi-K2 的词表规模更大，适合后续做 embedding 空间的宽覆盖观察。
summary.en: Kimi-K2's larger vocabulary makes it interesting for broader embedding-space coverage.

inModel.zh: 首版仍然只做词表级摘要，不展开 tokenizer 内部机制。
inModel.en: The first version keeps this at a vocabulary-summary level instead of tokenizer internals.

why.zh: 如果后续加入跨模型 token 对齐，Kimi-K2 会是很有意思的对照点。
why.en: If cross-model token alignment is added later, Kimi-K2 will be a useful comparison point.

compared.zh: 它在词表规模上比 DeepSeek-V3 更激进，也比 Qwen3 更适合观察大词表对空间分布的影响。
compared.en: Its vocabulary is more aggressive than DeepSeek-V3 and offers a different large-vocab perspective from Qwen3.

summary.zh: Kimi-K2 的 embedding 统计适合作为“大词表 + 超大 MoE”背景下的输出空间观察入口。
summary.en: Kimi-K2 embedding stats are useful for viewing output-space geometry under a large-vocab, large-MoE regime.

inModel.zh: 首版投影散点仍为示意性数据，但预留了和真实脚本产出对齐的结构。
inModel.en: The first release uses illustrative projection points but keeps a schema aligned with future real-script outputs.

why.zh: embedding 是最容易和 lm_head、词表规模一起读的模块。
why.en: Embedding is the easiest module to read jointly with lm_head and vocabulary scale.

compared.zh: 相比 DeepSeek-V3，Kimi-K2 更强调超大专家池带来的整体尺度感；embedding 则提供了一个相对稳定的切入口。
compared.en: Compared with DeepSeek-V3, Kimi-K2 emphasizes the overall feel of a much larger expert pool; embedding offers a steadier entry point.

summary.zh: Kimi-K2 也沿着 MLA 路线展开，因此适合和 DeepSeek-V3 放在同一视角比较。
summary.en: Kimi-K2 also follows an MLA-oriented route, making it natural to compare with DeepSeek-V3.

inModel.zh: 页面里的 attention 区块用于解释 cache 与吞吐角度的取舍，而不是还原全部细节。
inModel.en: The attention block explains tradeoffs from the cache-and-throughput perspective rather than reproducing all details.

why.zh: 如果用户关心推理效率，这里通常是进入对比阅读的第一站。
why.en: If the reader cares about inference efficiency, this is usually the first stop.

compared.zh: 和 DeepSeek-V3 同样偏 MLA，但在页面叙事里，Kimi-K2 更适合作为“大规模实现”的对照样本。
compared.en: Like DeepSeek-V3, it leans toward MLA, but in page narrative Kimi-K2 serves as the large-scale implementation reference.

summary.zh: Kimi-K2 在这张页面里最值得看的就是超大专家池和 active params 的组合。
summary.en: Kimi-K2 is most interesting here for its very large expert pool combined with controlled active parameters.

inModel.zh: 首版把专家矩阵统计放在这里，方便直接看到“规模更大时相似度结构会如何变化”的占位结果。
inModel.en: The first version places expert-matrix stats here so readers can directly inspect placeholder patterns at larger scale.

why.zh: 这是页面中最能体现 Kimi-K2 风格的模块。
why.en: This is the module that best captures Kimi-K2's character.

compared.zh: 相较 DeepSeek-V3 和 Qwen3，Kimi-K2 更适合作为“总参数量继续上探”时的参考点。
compared.en: Compared with DeepSeek-V3 and Qwen3, Kimi-K2 is the clearest reference point for what happens when total scale increases further.

summary.zh: Router 仍然只做结构位说明，后续可以作为样本级稀疏激活分析的入口。
summary.en: The router remains a structural explanation slot for now and can later host sample-level sparse-activation analysis.

inModel.zh: 在超大专家池背景下，这个位置尤其值得后续扩展。
inModel.en: With such a large expert pool, this slot is especially worth expanding later.

why.zh: 如果后续需要解释专家利用率，这里会成为最关键的桥梁模块。
why.en: If expert utilization needs to be explained later, this becomes the key bridge module.

compared.zh: MVP 里仍然只做说明，不上复杂统计。
compared.en: In the MVP, this remains explanatory only without complex stats.

summary.zh: 共享专家模块保留在主图里，便于和 DeepSeek-V3 对照。
summary.en: The shared-expert module remains in the main diagram to support comparison with DeepSeek-V3.

inModel.zh: 首版只展示摘要统计，不在这里展开更细粒度的矩阵分析。
inModel.en: The first version shows summary stats only and does not expand into finer matrix analysis here.

why.zh: 它提供了一个观察“共享能力”是否随规模变化而变化的入口。
why.en: It offers a path to inspect whether shared capacity changes with model scale.

compared.zh: 和 DeepSeek-V3 一样，这里值得保留为一级模块；和 Qwen3 相比则更多是扩展位。
compared.en: Like DeepSeek-V3, it is worth keeping as a first-level module; compared with Qwen3 it is more of an extension slot.

summary.zh: Decoder stack 在 Kimi-K2 上更像“把 MLA 和超大 MoE 串起来的容器”。
summary.en: In Kimi-K2, the decoder stack acts more like the container binding MLA and a very large MoE together.

inModel.zh: 图中仍然使用统一抽象，避免因为规模过大导致视觉过载。
inModel.en: The diagram still uses the same abstraction to avoid visual overload at larger scale.

why.zh: 这有助于在不增加页面复杂度的前提下保持可比较性。
why.en: This keeps models comparable without increasing page complexity.

compared.zh: Kimi-K2 更强调整体尺度，但在页面里仍沿用和另外两者一致的主图语法。
compared.en: Kimi-K2 emphasizes overall scale, but the page preserves the same visual grammar as the other two.

summary.zh: LM head 与 embedding 的配对统计仍然是最容易跨模型对齐的一组默认结果。
summary.en: LM head paired with embedding remains the easiest default stat set to align across models.

inModel.zh: 首版中把它作为轻量结果区的一部分，而不是主叙事模块。
inModel.en: In the first release, it lives more as a lightweight result block than as the main narrative module.

why.zh: 它适合快速替换为真实数据，不会牵动页面结构。
why.en: It is easy to replace with real data later without changing page structure.

compared.zh: 对于 Kimi-K2，这里更像一个稳态对照位，用来平衡 MoE 模块带来的巨大信息量。
compared.en: For Kimi-K2, this acts as a stable comparison slot that balances the large amount of information in the MoE module.
